senses.gloss: --A hill of शाकद्वीप. It was here that Bali who fell unconscious in the देवासुर war was treated with सञ्जीविनी विद्या। भा. VIII. ११. ४६; Br. II. १९. ८९; वा. ४९. ८३; Vi. II. 4. ६२. [page१-139+ ३२]
--Daughter of जरासन्ध and a queen of Kamsa. After her husband's death she went to her father's place and reported the circumstances in which her husband was killed. भा. X. ५०. 1-2; Vi. V. २२. 1.

--That relating to the use of अस्त्रस्। परसुराम learnt the four aspects from शिव;
1: Br. III. २१. ७९; २५. ३९; ३२. ५९; ३४. ३४.
learnt by कृष्ण and राम.
2: Vi. V. २१. २३.
--the teacher of weapons of warfare: 4 kinds are mentioned; throwing by machines, by hands, thrown simply, and taking back after throwing away. M. २१५. ४१.
